Tik Tik Tik | Review By Manoj Aswin | A Good Entertainer with a Successful First Try

3.75 out of 53.75/5
Posted By : Manoj Aswin | Date : 26-07-2018

Tik Tik Tik,a pretty Good First try.....

Good movie but slow in first half and good moving to the plot in the second half and a bad twist at the last but a very good ending. Music is awesome especially when it’s D. Imman’s 100th movie and he’s good.

Comedy and VFX are good.

But everyone should understand that this is first try So we should encourage attempts like these since it’s like a baby trying to walk for the first time and if the baby falls u can't say to the baby that I am walking good so u have too.

My Final Verdict, Considering the fact that it’s new try in Indian cinema I’ll give it a 3.75/5
